outcome: oxidative stress parameters (Total Antioxidant Status (TAS), Superoxide Dismutase (SOD) activity, Glutathione Peroxidase (GPx) activity, Glutathione Reductase (GR) activity)
cohort: The study included umbilical cord blood from 168 newborns (60 delivered vaginally and 108 by caesarean section).
finding: SOD activity was significantly lower in newborns with Apgar scores below 10 at 5 minutes compared to newborns with the highest Apgar points.
mod_finding: In caesarean-delivered neonates, SOD activity was significantly lower in those with Apgar scores less than 10, a finding potentially related to bupivacaine-induced oxidative stress.
cross-section timing: At birth (via umbilical cord blood sampling)
